plugins.name: panma-harness
plugins.description: Multi-agent supervisor harness. Auto-dispatches role-based subagents (designer, executors, verifier, rule-applier) with Ralph loop, retry budget, and project-defined domain executors. Also writes a per-turn session title sidecar that panma-hud reads to keep the statusline name in sync with the current request.

plugins.name: panma-hud
plugins.description: Heads-up display for Claude Code. Statusline showing model, session title (with panma-harness sidecar override), context % with inline 200k+ warning, and 5h/7d quota utilization, plus live panma-harness cycle state (phase, workers, retries, STOP) when .harness/state.json is present.
